items.raw_excerpt: The "Loja do Cidadão" (Citizen's Shop) in Olhão was officially opened on 28 September and introduced four key public services to the Ria Shopping centre: the Tax and Customs Authority, the Social Security Institute, the Institute of Registries and Notaries, and the "Espaço Cidadão" (Citizen's Space).
